scope: Identity-bound retained control reads and completed Windows Move Undo after containing-parent renames; source/native checkpoint, not full terminal retirement or a package release.
implementation: Copy and Move use one native Windows volume/ID resolver; previous Copy implementation and all call sites moved without a compatibility shim
A stored path is admitted only when it still opens the exact ordinary directory ID; otherwise the shared resolver opens the recorded native object
Local Move journals are read relative to verified directory handles and reject reparse files
Completed same-volume Replace and cross-volume inverse/controller proof reads follow original private directory identities rather than recreated old names
Completed recovery plans retain only the registry footprint and acknowledge verified history after central snapshot checks; they never replay former payload paths
Pending plan execution pins original private namespaces, and paired writers pin and verify the private directory before either journal write

Late non-overwrite forward teardown with an already removed private directory captures explicit namespace absence under its verified original destination parent; inverse or retained directories are never inferred retired
